usual.en: Others most probably joined in the merriment, and the dinner party continued as usual.
usual.zh: 其他人多半也会加入这欢乐的气氛中，然后晚宴照常进行。

usual.en: When super is placed before an adjective, it means very or more than usual.
usual.zh: 当 super 放在形容词前面时，它表示非常或超出寻常。

usual.en: And, as usual, we'll be learning some useful new words and phrases as well.
usual.zh: 而且，像往常一样，我们还会学习一些实用的新单词和短语。

usual.en: And, as usual, we'll learn some useful new words and phrases too.
usual.zh: 像往常一样，我们也会学习一些实用的新单词和短语。

usual.en: And, as usual, we'll be learning some useful new vocabulary as well.
usual.zh: 像往常一样，我们也会学习一些实用的新词汇。

useful.en: And at the same time, we will learn some important and useful English vocabulary!
useful.zh: 与此同时，我们将学习一些重要且实用的英语词汇！

useful.en: Normally “yes” or “no”. They’re useful when you need something clear and specific.
useful.zh: 通常是“是”或“否”。当你需要明确且具体的事情时，它们非常有用。

useful.en: There are also refocusing questions, which are really useful when a discussion goes off track.
useful.zh: 还有重新聚焦类问题，当讨论偏离正题时，这类问题真的非常有用。

useful.en: That’s what we’ll be discussing in this programme, along with some useful new vocabulary.
useful.zh: 这就是我们在本期节目中要讨论的内容，此外还有一些实用的新词汇。

useful.en: Third, using a language in real life situations whenever possible is really useful.
useful.zh: 第三，尽可能在现实生活中使用一门语言真的很有用。

used.en: Archeologists have found tools and jewelry and pottery, and also seals used for commerce.
used.zh: 考古学家发现了工具、珠宝和陶器，以及用于商业的印章。

used.en: Stones from Aztec temples were used to construct churches and palaces and government buildings.
used.zh: 阿兹特克神庙的石头被用来建造教堂、宫殿和政府大楼。

used.en: Andie Sophia Fontaine, who used to work in McDonald’s, now edits The Iceland Review.
used.zh: Andie Sophia Fontaine 曾经在 McDonald’s 工作过，现在是《冰岛评论》的编辑。

used.en: But humans used many different formats for storing written information before books were invented.
used.zh: 但在书籍发明之前，人类使用许多不同的格式来存储书面信息。

used.en: The government has used these categories as part of its approach to managing diversity.
used.zh: 政府将这些类别作为其管理多元化方法的一部分。

user.en: Their algorithms are designed to show users the posts most likely to attract their attention.
user.zh: 它们的算法旨在向用户展示最能吸引他们注意力的帖子。

user.en: As one user on Facebook humorously put it, “I live in Scotland.
user.zh: 正如 Facebook 上的一位用户幽默地指出的那样：“我住在苏格兰。

user.en: Are you studying English to become a confident English speaker and a confident English user?
user.zh: 你学英语是为了成为一个自信的英语发言者和自信的英语使用者吗？

user.en: He legalises cannabis, a drug he is personally a heavy user of.
user.zh: 他将大麻合法化，而他自己就是大麻的重度使用者。

user.en: The introduction of AI has turned some users away from social media.
user.zh: AI 的引入让一些用户远离了社交媒体。

useless.en: It's not a silver bullet, but it's not entirely useless either.
useless.zh: 它不是万灵药，但也并非完全没用。

useless.en: Now, none of this means these tools are useless.
useless.zh: 现在，这并不意味着这些工具毫无用处。

useless.en: That kind of delayed feedback is nearly useless.
useless.zh: 那种延迟的反馈几乎毫无用处。

useless.en: It was "useless" in a survival sense. Yet, the humans had kept it alive, feeding it and cleaning it for months.
useless.zh: 从生存的角度来看，它是“无用的”。然而，人类却让它活了下来，连续几个月给它喂食、帮它清理。
字典有时其实挺没用的。

usage.en: Basically understanding, comprehension, needs to come before usage.
usage.zh: 基本上，理解必须先于使用。

usage.en: They used a technique called forensic linguistics, which is the study of language in a legal context, and the experts noted identical usages of certain uncommon words and specific, idiosyncratic grammatical constructions.
usage.zh: 他们使用了一种叫做司法语言学（forensic linguistics）的技术，这是在法律背景下对语言的研究，专家们注意到某些不常见词汇的相同用法以及特定的、独特的语法结构。
